title: Software Engineer
description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. Group/Division The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications. What You'll Do In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise. Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The LS-SWIFT Division of KLA’s Global Products Group provides patterned wafer inspection systems for high-volume semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to deliver market-leading cost of ownership in defect detection for a broad range of applications in the production of semiconductors. Customers from the foundry, logic, memory, automotive, MEMS, advanced packaging and other markets rely upon high-sample wafer inspection information generated by LS-SWIFT products. LS (Laser Scanning) systems enable cost-effective patterned wafer defect detection for the industry’s most sophisticated process technologies deployed in leading-edge foundry, logic, DRAM, and NAND fabs. SWIFT (Simultaneous Wafer Inspection at Fast Throughput) systems deliver all-wafer-surface (frontside, backside, and edge) macro inspection that is critical for automotive IC, MEMS, and advanced packaging processes as well as foundry/logic and memory fabs. LS-SWIFT operates from a global footprint that includes the US, Singapore, India and Germany, and serves a worldwide customer base across Asia, Europe and North America. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. title: QA Analyst - Intern
description: Job Description: Intern: QA Analyst About Us: UpEnergy is the leading developer of anti-poverty climate impact projects in Africa. We accelerate decarbonization and while delivering long-term health and income benefits in local communities. We provide life-improving clean technologies and carbon reduction and capture projects that protect the local environment, deliver health benefits and cleaner air, and reduce poverty through financial savings and employment. Our project sustainably benefits and enables people to live better lives within more climate resilient communities. To date, UpEnergy has built over 95 emission reduction projects, impacted over 4 million lives, and reduced over 3 million tons of CO2 Emissions across 10 countries. All UpEnergy’s work is characterized by respect for the people we serve, rigorous measurement, deep local knowledge and established teams on the ground to ensure the highest impact and results. We do all this through our commitment to drive long-term business growth through technical innovation, close customer engagement and increased data-driven decision making. The UpEnergy team continues to grow, across multiple African countries, from 20 to over 170+ full time team members in the past two years, reflecting the growth of the company for which we now seek incredible, like-minded talent who are excited to join us in delivering even more impact. Learn more here: UpEnergy Group Why This Role As Carbon Data & QC Ops grows in scale and complexity — more markets, more monthly cycles, more deliverables going to field teams, leadership, auditors and registries — quality and consistency checks need a dedicated owner. This role builds that layer: a second pair of eyes across the team's output before it ships, so reliability doesn't depend on one person catching everything alone. The role starts high-level — general quality assurance across data, forms, reports and tools. As trust and familiarity build, scope naturally grows into broader day-to-day operational support. Role Summary Own quality assurance across the team's deliverables — data, forms, reports, dashboards, and working tools — catching errors early and keeping output reliable and consistent before it goes out. Key Responsibilities Quality review: check deliverables — data outputs, forms, reports, dashboards — for accuracy and consistency before they ship. Source verification: spot-check numbers and records against source data. Review logging: keep a simple, current log of what was checked and what was found — no review without a record. Early escalation: flag anything uncertain the same day rather than guess or sit on it. Day-to-day support: pick up broader operational and data tasks as capacity and trust grow — this role is designed to expand, not stay fixed. Candidate Profile Must-Haves High attention to detail; methodical and comfortable with repetitive, precision-dependent work. Clear written communication — much of the work is asynchronous review and reporting. Proactive problem-solver — surfaces issues with a proposed fix, not just a flag. Reliable and self-directed; this role runs on a checklist and a log, not close supervision. Nice-to-Haves (bonus, not gating) Familiarity with survey/data-collection tools (e.g. XLSForm, SurveyCTO, ODK, KoboToolbox). Basic SQL and/or Python — enough to spot-check a query or re-run a script and read its output. Prior exposure to carbon markets, M&E, or program data — shortens ramp-up, not required. Explicitly Not Required Not a developer hire — no new feature-building or software-engineering expected. No prior carbon-credit or MRV expertise required. What You'll Gain Direct, hands-on mentorship from the Senior Data Analyst on real carbon-market data and operations — not shadow work, actual production deliverables. Broad exposure across data, forms, reporting and tooling — a strong general foundation, not a narrow niche. Growing ownership — the role expands as trust builds, not a role capped at one task forever. A structured ramp-up with regular feedback, not thrown in blind. Decision Rights Tier What it covers Flags & logs — no ask needed Any discrepancy found during review, however small. Decides independently Obvious fixes (typos, formatting); re-running a check after correcting an input error. Never their call What ships externally; final sign-off on anything going to leadership, auditors or registries — that stays with Shoaib. Success — First 90 Days Deliverables going out to field teams or leadership have an independent check behind them. A current, complete review log exists and reflects real work — no gaps. The role has picked up at least one recurring day-to-day task beyond pure review. Practical Details Reports to: Shoaib Ahmed Noorani, Senior Data Analyst, Carbon Data & QC Ops. Engagement: Full-time preferred; initial 3-month trial with extension based on performance. Location: In Office (Bangalore) Why Join Us? Not your average 9-to-5 UpEnergy encourages teamwork, creativity, and we’re not afraid to get our hands dirty. We stay close to our market, understand our customers, and have a lot of fun while doing our work! If you’re looking for a conventional 9-to-5, you’d be missing out on our adventures! Opportunity to do things in a new way As one of the largest compliance credit issuer in Africa, we need to be constantly improving and rethinking our way of work. This means endless opportunities for a self-starter to initiate new ways of doing things or experimenting ways to help us improve. Personal and Career Growth Wouldn’t it be a pity to spend so much time working but not growing and learning? At UpEnergy we value both personal and professional growth, and we want to grow as a team. From classroom training to coffee chats to performance review, we want to support every team member to grow into the best version they can. Create Lasting Impact Our clean energy products bring positive impact to both our planet earth and for the low-income communities we work in. We don’t just focus on sales – we follow up and truly understand our customers to make sure that they continue to benefit from our products. Your work will create much longer-lasting impact than what you can see! Compensation: The Intern will receive a stipend. Internship Duration: 6 months Start date & Location: The position is based in Chennai, India. We are looking for the right candidate to start as soon as possible.

description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: At PayPal, we’re literally reinventing how the world pays and gets paid. We understand that it’s about people. We connect individuals to let them shop, get paid, donate and send money using today’s technology with the confidence that comes from the security and control PayPal enables. Are you ready to help us change the world? The world’s leading payments company, PayPal, brings together a family of brands that are revolutionizing the way people move money. description: Description Job Title: Software Engineer - Java Employment Type: Permanent Work Location: Chennai India - Hybrid About CloudBees CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Visit us at www.cloudbees.com. About The Role We use Claude Code every day and are pushing agentic AI further into how we work. If you want to be on a team figuring out what AI-assisted engineering actually looks like on a real, complex product (not a sandbox), this is it. CDRO (Continuous Delivery & Release Orchestration) is CloudBees' enterprise CD product. It's been running in production at some of the world's largest engineering orgs for over a decade. Hundreds of engineers depend on it to ship software safely and on schedule. We're a team of about 10, distributed across India, France, Spain, and the US. We're not chasing the next hype cycle feature. We operate a product real customers depend on, modernize it while keeping it stable, and do it with a small team that takes ownership seriously. Key Responsibilities Most teams try AI coding tools on greenfield work. We're doing something harder: applying them to a decade-old enterprise codebase with real customers depending on it. CDRO's core is Java 21 with a significant Groovy layer. The work is a mix of internal cleanup that makes the codebase easier to evolve, and direct improvements that make customers' lives better. Concretely: Own Java work across the core: REST API, pipeline execution engine, persistence layer Continuously reduce complexity: modernize older subsystems, shrink the product surface area where it makes sense, improve test coverage, and leave the codebase easier than you found it Use Claude Code as a normal part of your workflow, to move faster without skipping thought Write tests that prove things work. Shift-left, not "QA will catch it." Document what you build. We're async across timezones. If you know something the team needs to know, write it down. Actively avoid being a single point of failure for anything you own Qualifications Required: Solid Java. You've worked professionally at least 4 years developing Java software, in production codebases that weren't yours, in systems that mattered if they broke. Strong AI awareness: you know what Claude Code, or Cursor, etc. do. You've played with some of them at least. Relational database experience: SQL, JPA/Hibernate, schema migrations. Oracle or PostgreSQL background is a strong advantage. Comfort in large, mature codebases. You can navigate unfamiliar code, form a hypothesis, test it, and stay functional when you don't understand everything at once. Testing discipline. You write unit and integration tests as part of the work, not after. Honest communication. If something is blocked or broken, we need to know. We're async and distributed. Strong plus: Active use of Claude Code to ship real work, not just tab completion. Bonus: you want to push it much further than you do today. Groovy. Willingness to pick it up fast matters more than prior credentials. Kubernetes/Helm: deploying and debugging workloads, not just using them. Experience evolving established systems: migrations, incremental rewrites, dependency upgrades. Preferred (not mandatory): Jenkins or CI/CD internals Distributed systems infrastructure: message brokers (ActiveMQ, Artemis, RabbitMQ), coordination (Zookeeper) React/TypeScript: the UI is adjacent and not your main domain, but not being afraid of it helps Who This Is For You're a Java engineer who finds large, evolved codebases interesting rather than off-putting. With ~10 people on the team, you'll touch meaningful parts of the system fast. You'd rather evolve a product real enterprises depend on than build a greenfield service nobody's relying on yet. title: Senior Software Engineer - Valor India
description: Valor PayTech fosters a vibrant and nurturing work atmosphere that motivates employees to innovate and excel. The culture is deeply rooted in collaboration and ongoing development, offering team members abundant opportunities for professional advancement and skill improvement. Emphasizing innovation excellence and cultural expansion, the company greatly values the diversity of its workforce, believing it to be a cornerstone of its success. Senior Software Engineer POS / Payment Systems Experience 7+ years Job Type Full-time Domain Point of Sale (POS) / Payment Systems / Retail Technology Location Chennai, India Reports To Engineering Manager Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of software development experience , strong expertise in POS and payment systems , and hands-on experience developing secure, reliable, and scalable payment applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong combination of C/C++ payment/POS development and Java/Kotlin-based Android application development , with a solid understanding of ISO 8583, Terminal Management Systems (TMS), payment transaction processing, the Android SDK, and modern Android architecture . The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, debugging, and maintaining POS/payment solutions while collaborating closely with product, QA, hardware, and backend teams. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer who can work across the complete POS software stack — from payment transaction processing and ISO 8583 messaging to Android applications, APIs, device integration, and debugging . The successful candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of complex technical problems, driving solutions independently, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performance POS payment solutions . Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain POS and payment applications for Android-based payment terminals. Develop and maintain payment-related components using Android, C, and C++. Implement and integrate ISO 8583 message formats and transaction flows. Work with Terminal Management Systems (TMS) for terminal configuration, application deployment, updates, and management. Develop Android applications using Java and Kotlin. Design robust and maintainable Android applications using MVVM and Repository architecture. Implement asynchronous operations using Kotlin Coroutines and WorkManager. Develop local data persistence using SQLite. Integrate backend services using Retrofit, Volley, and JSON. Work with Android components including ViewModel, LiveData, Navigation Component, and Jetpack Compose. Integrate and maintain third-party libraries and SDKs such as Firebase, Glide, and Picasso. Develop responsive and user-friendly POS interfaces following Material Design and UI/UX best practices. Integrate payment SDKs, device SDKs, and hardware-related APIs as required. Analyse and resolve complex application, transaction, integration, and device-level issues. Perform debugging and root-cause analysis across application, middleware, and POS/device layers. Collaborate with backend teams on API design and payment transaction integration. Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices. Write unit/integration tests and support QA teams in troubleshooting and defect resolution. Use Git for source-code management and version control. Use Postman for API testing, validation, and troubleshooting. Work with Android Studio and Visual Studio for development and debugging. Contribute to technical design, architecture decisions, documentation, and development estimates. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and provide technical guidance to the development team. Required Technical Skills POS & Payment Technologies Strong hands-on experience in POS / payment systems. Good understanding of payment transaction processing and POS transaction flows. Strong knowledge of ISO 8583 messaging and transaction processing. Experience with Terminal Management Systems (TMS). Experience working with payment terminals, POS devices, or similar embedded/payment environments. Experience with C and C++ development. Android Development Strong experience with Java and Kotlin. Hands-on experience with the Android SDK and Android application development. Strong understanding of MVVM architecture. Experience with: Kotlin Coroutines SQLite Retrofit Volley JSON Firebase Glide Picasso ViewModel LiveData Jetpack Compose Navigation Component Repository Pattern WorkManager API & Integration Strong experience with REST API integration. Experience with JSON-based web services. Hands-on experience using Postman for API testing and debugging. Understanding of client-server communication and API error handling. Development Tools & Technologies Android Studio, Visual Studio Git, Postman XML, Material Design Jetpack / Android Architecture Components Software Engineering Skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent debugging and troubleshooting capabilities. Ability to understand and work across application, payment, API, and device layers. Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles. Ability to write clean, maintainable, reusable, and production-quality code. Experience with the software development lifecycle, code reviews, testing, and release processes. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced product development environment. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, or a related field. 7+ years of professional software development experience. Previous experience in payment, banking, fintech, retail, POS, acquiring, or transaction-processing systems is highly desirable. Experience working with Android-based POS/payment terminals will be an advantage. Experience integrating payment, hardware, or device-specific SDKs is preferred. description: Letter of Credit Servicing - Trade Finance - 4 to 12 Years We are hiring for Senior Analyst and Lead Analyst positions in Structured and Documentary Trade (Letters of Credit) with a leading global banking organisation. These roles involve managing complex LC structures, overseeing transaction servicing, resolving escalations, strengthening operational controls, and driving process improvements.
